# Corpus AI

Corpus AI is the public brand of Corpus Localization LLC. Corpus Localization (certified translations) is a line under Corpus AI. This site is a directory. It does not take payment.

## Lines (live)

- Certified translation (Corpus Localization): https://corpuslocalization.com — $19.99/page eligible standard documents, ATA Corporate Member #M-189351, USCIS-purpose Certificate of Accuracy, 24-hour standard delivery. B2B: law firms, HR, volume.
- GBP Reinstatement Packet: https://nshempstead1.github.io/corpus-ai/ — $149, 4 business hours. You submit. No Google login.
- Amazon POA Packet: https://nshempstead1.github.io/amazon-poa/ — $299, 6 business hours. You submit. No Seller Central login.
- VPAT Sprint: https://nshempstead1.github.io/vpat-sprint/ — $1,995, 5 business days, ≤12 screens. You sign the ACR.
- Hearing Evidence Binder: https://nshempstead1.github.io/ua-hearing-binder/ — $79, 1 business day. Claimant-side, not B2B.
- Order Desk (same LLC, different product URL): https://nshempstead1.github.io/order-desk/ — $29/mo Stripe Payment Link SLA watchdog. Not a packet.
- Watch Desk: https://nshempstead1.github.io/watch-desk/ — $12/mo uptime + OpenClaw $299+$49, Instantly Desk $29, Seller Central Desk $99, Review Blast $39, Rank Grid $19, Card Retry $29.

B2B catalog: https://nshempstead1.github.io/corpus-ai-hub/b2b.html

## Next B2B (not live, no payment)

- Google Ads appeal packet — planned $249. Policy Appeal Form file. Not Merchant Center DFY rebuilds.
- Stripe / Shopify Payments KYC packet — planned $199. Exact-match docs + in-thread letter. No logins.

## Not sold

- Chargeback representment packets (ChargebackKit $19 / Shopify apps own that slot)
- DSAR fulfillment (needs the customer’s systems; Obtainer-class SaaS)
- Unbounded AI retainers / “your own Claw” mystery boxes (priced OpenClaw install is on Watch Desk)
- SEO retainers, AI websites
- Licensed medical practice, food, manufactured physical goods

## What we do not do

- Packet storefronts do not take platform logins. Watch Desk Seller Central Desk is a separate $99/mo SKU.
- Watch Desk sells OpenClaw install ($299+$49). This hub does not take that payment.
- We do not sell unbounded AI retainers, licensed medical care, food, or manufactured physical goods.
- We do not guarantee Google, Amazon, procurement, hearing, or USCIS outcomes.
- We do not fabricate documents.
- We are not corpusai.org (preventive medicine) and not corpusai.io (cybersecurity).
